title: Shipping Tracking
content: Customers can track their orders using the tracking link sent by email after dispatch. If tracking information is unavailable, they should contact support with their order number.

title: Delayed Delivery
content: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 7 business days after dispatch. If an order is delayed beyond the estimated delivery date, support should investigate the shipment status.

title: Refund Policy
content: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery for eligible items. Refunds are issued after the return has been inspected and approved.

title: Refund Processing Time
content: Approved refunds generally take 5 to 10 business days to appear in the original payment method. Processing time may vary depending on the bank.

title: Payment Failed
content: If a payment fails, customers should verify their card details, check available funds, and retry. If the problem persists, they should contact their bank or customer support.

title: Duplicate Payment
content: If a customer notices duplicate charges for one order, support should verify the transaction records before advising on reversal or refund.

title: Order Cancellation
content: Customers may request cancellation before an order is dispatched. Once dispatched, the order may need to follow the return process.

title: Damaged Product
content: Customers who receive a damaged product should contact support with their order number and photos of the damage. Support will review eligibility for replacement or refund.
